title: Hinomori Shiho — With Some Embarrassment〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I'm staying in rhythm and my fingers are moving well. We should sound just fine when the four of us play together tomorrow.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (It sounded like they've all been practicing over the holidays.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (That's all the more reason I need to stay in playing shape.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I should probably go over that part again one last time later. I kept rushing ahead during our last practices for the year, so...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Oh, that's right. I promised to go out with her today...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hang on... You're early. We're not supposed to leave for another twenty minutes.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: How can I not be early?! I'm just so excited about us going out together!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Also, leaving early would mean getting to spend more time with you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Yeah, we're going out... But all we're doing is taking a quick walk to visit that shrine by our house...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Still, if she's ready to go, I probably shouldn't keep her waiting...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Alright...
Just give me a second to get my things.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Notice anything about my scarf♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh... It's the brooch I gave you.
You decided to wear it already?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It looks nice, and it goes with your scarf.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You think so? I'm so glad you're saying that. Then...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Why don't you put yours on as well?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Remember what you said, Shii?
You promised that we'd go out with our brooches on.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Walking around like that is gonna feel...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Please, Shii!
We're going to have an absolutely wonderful time if we go out together with our brooches! I'm sure of it!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I couldn't ask for a better way to begin the new year...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I don't even have to draw a fortune...
There's no way my luck isn't beyond wonderful!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, you don't really know until you draw one...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyway, you wait outside for me while I get ready.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, but... If I were to help you, we might be able to leave even sooner, no?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. It's very chilly out, so you'll need to put on a scarf, a pair of gloves and...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, a warm hat.
We wouldn't want you to catch a cold!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, I don't need any help getting dressed...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm gonna get changed, so please get out. If you don't, I'm leaving my brooch behind.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What?! N-No, I wouldn't want you to do that...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (It's the start of a new year, but Shizuku's still just herself.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Anyway, what else do I need?
My brooch. I'll put it...
